app.name: Halo CE Wii
app.long_description:
Unofficial Homebrew Channel stub for a future Halo: Combat Evolved engine port.
This build lists your cache files, draws the first structure BSP with a lightmap or bitmap from that cache on GX, and runs OpenCE game_tick. Script special forms execute. Opening a map streams squad starting locations, actor variants, weapon magazines, projectile damage, biped collision models, and up to 64 KiB of animation frame data. A structure collision BSP is copied when it fits in 4 MiB. The 23 MiB Xbox cache is not mapped. No game data is included.
Not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios, Halo Studios, Activision, or Bungie. JojoXDK's private Wii work in progress is a different project and is not included here.
Stub no oficial del canal Homebrew. No es jugable y no incluye datos del juego. HOME sale al loader.
